bounded_claim: This deterministic test examines only whether the native AuthorityResolution representation permits a CONFLICT composed solely of identical supplied observations and whether V06 then treats that supplied status as a consequence-boundary conflict. It does not establish observation authenticity, resolver correctness, distributed consensus, jurisdictional freshness, external provenance, or production deployment behavior.
governing_question: Can the native AuthorityResolution representation accept CONFLICT containing two identical AuthorityState observations, and can that homogeneous conflict cause V06 to withhold an otherwise-authorized consequence as CONSEQUENCE_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT?
positive_controls: The active authority and permit are valid for SEND before the consequence-boundary resolver is invoked.
A CONFLICT containing two materially different AuthorityState observations remains constructible.
title: Homogeneous Conflict Consequence Refusal
